name: rowsmith-mcp

tools.name: generate_test_data
tools.description: Generate realistic fake test data (CSV, JSON or SQL INSERTs) from a table schema. Free and rate-limited: up to 500 rows and 50 columns per call. No real person's data is used as input and no record is derived from a real person; emails, phones, card numbers, SSN-shaped and IBAN-shaped values come only from reserved or invalid ranges. The same schema and seed give byte-identical output for the same generator version (sent as x-generator-version). For more than about 50 rows, pass output_path to write a file instead of returning the data. Send schemas only, never real data.

name.description: Column name: lowercase letters, digits and _

type.description: One of: uuid, sequence (start, step, prefix, pad), integer (min, max), decimal (min, max, scale), boolean (p_true), enum (values, weights), date (from, to: YYYY-MM-DD), datetime (from, to), first_name, last_name, full_name, email, phone, test_card, ssn_invalid, iban_invalid, text (min_words, max_words). Every column also takes null_rate.

seed.description: Seed; the same schema and seed give identical output for the same generator version (default 1)

table.description: Table name, used in SQL output (default data)

output_path.description: Write the data to this file instead of returning it (use for more than about 50 rows). Must be inside the working directory, or inside ROWSMITH_OUT_DIR when set; no '..' segments

overwrite.description: Replace output_path if it already exists (default false)

chaos.description: Deliberate misbehaviour for testing error handling

tools.name: list_column_types
tools.description: List the supported column types and the options each accepts.

tools.name: invalid_values
tools.description: Deliberately invalid TEST DATA values (malformed emails, declining or Luhn-invalid card numbers, malformed addresses, Unicode edge cases, invalid IBAN and SSN shapes), each with the reason it is invalid. Same seed, same output for the same catalogue version.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to keep, e.g. value,reason

chaos.description: Deliberate misbehaviour for testing error handling
